mapper.delete: DELETE FROM common_file WHERE ref_type = #{refType} AND ref_id = #{refId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, bt.type_code, bt.type_name, m.name AS member_name FROM board b LEFT JOIN board_type bt ON b.board_type_id = bt.board_type_id LEFT JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} AND b.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( board_type_id, member_id, title, content, thumbnail, source, source_url, is_pinned, is_active, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{boardTypeId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{thumbnail}, #{source}, #{sourceUrl}, #{isPinned}, #{isActive}, 'ACTIVE', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
UPDATE board SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT board_type_id, type_code, type_name, sort_order FROM board_type WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common_file ( ref_type, ref_id, file_name, stored_name, file_path, file_ext, file_size, mime_type, sort_order, is_active, created_at ) VALUES ( #{refType}, #{refId}, #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileExt}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{sortOrder}, 1, NOW() )
